mapper.sql: select rdr.delivery_id, rdr.task_id, rdr.run_id, rdr.project_id, p.project_name, rdr.provider, rdr.channel, rdr.pr_number, rdr.idempotency_key, rdr.external_id, rdr.delivery_status, rdr.failure_message, rdr.attempt_count, rdr.last_attempt_time, rdr.trigger_source, (case when rdr.content_snapshot is not null then 1 else 0 end) as has_content_snapshot, rdr.create_by, rdr.create_time, rdr.update_by, rdr.update_time from review_delivery_record rdr left join review_project p on p.project_id = rdr.project_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = p.dept_id left join sys_user owner on owner.user_id = p.owner_user_id
mapper.select: select content_snapshot from review_delivery_record where delivery_id = #{deliveryId} limit 1

select delivery_id, task_id, run_id, project_id, provider, channel, pr_number, idempotency_key, external_id, delivery_status, failure_message, attempt_count, last_attempt_time, trigger_source, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from review_delivery_record where idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} limit 1

select delivery_id, task_id, run_id, project_id, provider, channel, pr_number, idempotency_key, external_id, delivery_status, failure_message, attempt_count, last_attempt_time, trigger_source, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from review_delivery_record where task_id = #{taskId} and channel in ('DINGTALK_ROBOT', 'WECOM_ROBOT', 'FEISHU_BOT') order by last_attempt_time desc, delivery_id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into review_delivery_record (task_id, run_id, project_id, provider, channel, pr_number, idempotency_key, external_id, delivery_status, failure_message, attempt_count, last_attempt_time, trigger_source, content_snapshot, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{taskId}, #{runId}, #{projectId}, #{provider}, #{channel}, #{prNumber}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{externalId}, #{deliveryStatus}, #{failureMessage}, #{attemptCount}, #{lastAttemptTime}, #{triggerSource}, #{contentSnapshot}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{updateBy}, sysdate())
